approvers: Owner/director, and the main contractor or client for any non-standard spec
reason: We cover glazing with film and tape at well under a euro a square metre in material, and nobody asks us to pay about €19/m² for a coating. It would be a new budget line and a new supplier for something that is cheap to protect today.
objection: €19/m² is many times what film and tape cost us, and I've never seen it used in Malta. Where is a local job I can go and look at?
instead: Keep using protection film, tape and cardboard on the frames, and pay for cleaning at handover where needed.
would_change_my_mind: A local reference job I can visit, plus a free trial on one of my floors, and a price close to film cost, about €3 to 4/m² all-in.
